title: Jobs a bash command backgrounds outlive the session; SIGHUP skips cleanup
observed: After the run, two 'go run .' API servers from t2-kiln-3/api were still running, orphaned to launchd. Separately, SIGHUP (window close) ended kiln with no exit path: bash_background shells and SessionEnd hooks skipped.
expected: Background jobs are stopped when the session ends, including when the terminal window closes

fix.note: Verified live: closing the iTerm2 window of a real session (t2-kiln-4, build 9285da7) logged 'sighup: stopping' and ran the exit path in 90ms; no api processes left.
